Always prioritize the most recent confirmed location over assumed daily cycles, as this item has distinct, non-uniform destinations that change throughout the day.

General Note: My assumption that Felix’s items follow static paths is flawed. Items move between kitchen, living, and bedroom spots unpredictably. The glasses move to the bathroom in the morning and living room at night. The glass moves to the cupboard at night. The tablet moves to the nightstand. The mug’s location is highly variable, appearing at the kitchen table in the morning and the desk in the evening. Always prioritize the most recent confirmed location over assumed daily cycles, as these items have distinct, non-uniform destinations that change throughout the day.
